$comment: A bounded recipe (AGENTIC-R5 T4.6, F04): an ordered list of operator steps from one operator-semantics table, bound to that table by digest. It is a sidecar with its own recipe_version. A changed table no longer matches the recipe's digest, so its earlier check does not carry over. A new recipe does not inherit another recipe's qualification.

sha256.$comment: canonical JSON digest of the table (sorted keys, no whitespace)

applied_effects.$comment: effects already applied upstream; the checker adds those named by upstream artifacts

not_applied.$comment: every effect of the table the recipe does not apply, with the reason; an omission is never silent

tool.$comment: <tool_id>:<operation_id> of a tool contract whose operation lists this operator
